comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
New aide from Chapter 3, from Rescue NPCs that can be recruited. Once you saved him, you can recruit him in Amsterdam.

Aide Skill (Aide Level req):
Fire Prevention (11/13/3)
Prevention (8/7/9)
Sound Sleep (2/4/4)
Storage Assistance (0/13/0)
Double-Shot Defence (0/0/15)
Chain-Shot Defence (5/5/24)
Smoke Screen Defence (10/8/35)
Dutch (0/0/0)

Support Skill (Aide Level req):
Provisions +1 (5/0/0)
Mineral trading +1 (0/15/2)
Steering +1 (4/0/8)
Gunnery +1 (0/0/8)
Ballistics +1 (0/0/15)
Penetration +1 (0/0/20)
Repair +1 (3/5/10)

He is a copycat from old aide Sigfried but skill level requirements seem lowered.

Thanks for correcting, i was sleepy while typing this last night lol.

comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body: This aide is actually named Elvin.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: This particular aide can be found anywhere in the world that Rescue NPCs spawn (including those coordinates). If you're in a hurry, my best advice is to try the Balearic Islands, Open Sea zone -- it is the smallest sea that NPCs can spawn in, and you can tell immediately if any are present. Just sail between the ocean zones east/west or west/east until a Rescue icon appears. Hope you get the aide you want soon! Cheers.
